name: Steady-State Nonlinear Beam Radiance Estimation
aliases: Beam radiance estimation with curved beams
Nonlinear beam estimation of basic radiance
definition: A method to estimate basic radiance along a curved beam in continuously refractive media by integrating transmittance and scattering along the ray trajectory, using a photon map for density estimation.
summary: Steady-State Nonlinear Beam Radiance Estimation accurately computes in-scattering in refractive media by integrating radiance along curved beam trajectories, unlike methods assuming straight-line propagation.
